title: Stop paying for ten load balancers in Kubernetes
caption: Ingress explained in 40 seconds. Are you still paying for multiple cloud load balancers?

scenes.vo: Want to expose ten different microservices to the internet? If you spin up ten separate cloud load balancers, your monthly bill will explode.
scenes.heading: INGRESS
scenes.tagline: STOP PAYING FOR TEN LOAD BALANCERS

scenes.vo: That is why Kubernetes has Ingress. Think of it as a smart receptionist sitting right at your cluster's front door.
scenes.heading: THE RECEPTIONIST
scenes.line: ONE FRONT DOOR ROUTING EVERY VISITOR

scenes.vo: One single public IP receives all incoming web traffic, inspects the URL, and routes it to the target service.
scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS

scenes.vo: Instead of buying multiple expensive balancers, you define HTTP path rules right inside a single Ingress manifest.
scenes.heading: THE INGRESS RULE

scenes.vo: Ingress gives you one entrypoint, intelligent HTTP routing, and saves massive cloud money. Follow for more Kubernetes made simple.
scenes.heading: INGRESS
